query:
UPDATE syllabus_versions SET
               content_hash = $2,
               size_bytes = $3,
               content_changed_at = CASE WHEN $4 THEN NOW() ELSE content_changed_at END,
               last_checked_at = NOW(),
               next_check_at = $5,
               fetch_error = NULL,
               fetch_failures = 0
           WHERE id = $1
